dedupe_keys.name: benevento vehicle mounted co2 and urban climate sensor traces

description: The Zenodo release contains timestamped and georeferenced carbon-dioxide, temperature and humidity readings from three instrumented vehicles in Benevento, Italy. Each vehicle carried a low-power Sensirion SCD41 node and recorded position, time and vehicle identity while travelling across urban routes. The article describes one-to-five-second sampling within an area of about 11.37 square kilometres. Zenodo lists one CSV file under CC BY 4.0. The traces can check spatial interpolation or mobile sensing assumptions for an urban environmental simulation, but they are route samples, not a full fixed-station air-quality network. Sensor calibration, road selection, temporal sampling and proximity to traffic are limitations when treating them as neighbourhood exposure. A reviewer-assessed use is testing mobility-aware environmental observation in a city digital twin. model-urbanmicroclimatefoam is a related urban climate model, but no tracer conversion or CO2 transport fit was tested. The article gives an upload-style Zenodo URL; the canonical record and its metadata were opened. No CSV was downloaded.
